name: Germany

authorities.competent_authority: BfArM or PEI (depending on the product); validates the application and issues the national decision
authorities.ethics: Registered ethics committee assesses the Article 7 Part II elements; the authority's decision is bound by the ethics committee's Part II assessment
authorities.fee: The federal authority levies one combined fee that includes the ethics-committee fee. Proof of fee is in the CTIS Forms section, not Part II; follow the authority's invoicing instructions.

language_rules.rule: Documents intended for the participant or legal representative must be in German (AMG). The application dossier itself may be German or English.
language_rules.non_german_speakers: If enrolment of people who do not understand German is planned, add a commitment to qualified translation and to communication in a language each participant and representative understands throughout the trial (AKEK, 15 June 2024). An interpreter does not replace translated documents for a planned language group.

template.basis: EudraLex Volume 10 recruitment and informed-consent procedure template, version 2.0 (applies to new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026, including initial applications, additional Member States and Article 11 completions)

documents.content: How potential participants are identified, approached, informed, given time to decide and consented; who conducts the consent interview; capacity, vulnerable populations, remote elements, interpreters and re-consent where relevant. Every population pathway in the plan (minors, adults without capacity, impartial witness, emergency) needs its section completed.
documents.drafting_notes_de: CTIS Teil II, Abschnitt K. Pflichtdokument. Verwaltungsdokument: Deutsch oder Englisch zulässig; Antworten in dieser Vorlage auf Deutsch. Keine Unterschrift bei Einreichung. Grundlage: EudraLex-Vorlage „Recruitment and informed consent procedure“ Version 2.0 (gilt für neue Teil-II-Einreichungen ab 1. September 2026). Für jede Population mit eigenem Einwilligungsweg (Minderjährige, nicht Einwilligungsfähige, Notfall, unparteiischer Zeuge) den jeweiligen Abschnitt ausfüllen; Abschnitte 1.6, 2.3, 3.2, 4.4, 5.3 und 6.4 mit den deutschen Anforderungen nach §§ 40a, 40b AMG füllen (z. B. Aufklärung durch Prüfarzt/Ärztin, Ausdrückliche Einwilligung in die Datenverarbeitung nach § 40b Abs. 6 AMG, qualifizierte Übersetzungen bei nicht deutschsprachigen Teilnehmenden).

documents.trigger_text: Advertisements, posters, social-media items, scripts, website views, audio or video texts or other material used to recruit participants.
documents.content: Final blank form. Identify the study clearly without promotional claims about the medicine or the site; payment must not dominate. If a call centre is used, identify its role and submit the call script.

documents.name_en: Participant information and informed consent form, one set per population
documents.content: Blank German information sheet and consent form for each population that can enter the trial. See population_sets for which sets the plan needs.

documents.name_en: Other information given before the participation decision
documents.trigger_text: Any additional leaflet or information material handed out with the consent package before the person decides.

documents.name_en: German translations of endpoint-related patient-facing documents
documents.trigger_text: Questionnaires, diaries, participant cards and similar documents related to primary or secondary endpoints. The English source goes with the protocol in Part I; the German translation goes in Part II (R area per the June 2026 Member State overview).
documents.note: Do not upload all operational participant materials by default; current EU guidance does not support requesting every patient-facing document or translation.

documents.content: Professional qualification, relevant clinical experience, trial experience and GCP knowledge. The German site template asks for a CV no more than one year old. Personal details come from the investigator; the assistant fills only trial fields.
documents.drafting_notes_de: CTIS Teil II, Abschnitt M. Pflichtdokument je Hauptprüfer/in und Prüfstelle. Deutsch oder Englisch zulässig. EU-Lebenslaufvorlage empfohlen, nicht verpflichtend; Lebenslauf nicht älter als ein Jahr; muss Qualifikation, klinische Erfahrung, Prüfungserfahrung und GCP-Kenntnisse zeigen. Persönliche Angaben werden von der Prüferin bzw. dem Prüfer geliefert: der Assistent trägt nur Studienangaben ein und erfindet keine persönlichen Daten. Nachweise der regulatorischen Schulung (CTR, AMG, GCP) separat als „M2_Regulatory training_<Prüfer/in>_<Prüfstelle>“ einreichen.

documents.content: Evidence of training covering CTR, AMG and GCP according to the German curricular recommendations, current for the investigator's role.

documents.drafting_notes_de: CTIS Teil II, Abschnitt M. Pflichtdokument je Hauptprüfer/in und Prüfstelle. Deutsch oder Englisch zulässig. EU-Vorlage empfohlen. Keine zusätzliche Unterschrift, sofern nicht von der Ethikkommission verlangt. Die Angaben zu Interessen liefert die Prüferin bzw. der Prüfer selbst; der Assistent trägt nur Studientitel und EU-Prüfungsnummer ein.

template.basis: EU site-suitability template (CTAG); the current AKEK Germany site-suitability template is the recommended alternative; either must cover Annex I point 67

documents.note: Head of institution or delegate approves internally; AKEK instructs not to include the signature in the CTIS upload.
documents.filled_by: assistant; site fields left empty for the site
documents.drafting_notes_de: CTIS Teil II, Abschnitt N. Pflichtdokument, je Prüfstelle ein Dokument. Deutsch oder Englisch zulässig. Für Deutschland wird die aktuelle AKEK-Vorlage zur Eignung der Prüfstelle empfohlen; diese EU-Vorlage ist gleichwertig, wenn sie Anhang I Nr. 67 abdeckt. Leiter/in der Einrichtung oder Bevollmächtigte/r genehmigt intern; die Unterschrift NICHT in die in CTIS hochgeladene Fassung aufnehmen. Prüfstellenangaben (Name, Hauptprüfer/in, Teilnehmerzahl, Kennnummer) bleiben für das Prüfzentrum leer. Strahlenschutz: Falls eine Genehmigung nach § 31 StrlSchG nötig ist, die Unterlagen ebenfalls unter N hochladen.

documents.content: CTIS must contain the planned German sites, principal investigators, roles and planned participant numbers. A separate list, if used, goes without signatures under suitability of facilities.

documents.trigger_text: Medical exposure to ionising radiation or radioactive substances that requires a German authorisation or notification. Since 1 July 2025 routed through BfArM or PEI with the trial submission.
documents.note: The exact file set depends on the radiation procedure. Confirm the current BfArM or PEI route before submission. The naming guide gives no fixed code; use the next free N number under suitability of facilities.
sources: BfArM radiation authorisation procedure, effective 1 July 2025

documents.unless: trial.low_intervention and the German statutory conditions for other insurance are met
documents.content: No-fault trial-participant insurance proportionate to the risk, with at least EUR 500,000 per case of death or continuing incapacity for work. The certificate must identify the trial or clearly establish coverage in Germany.
Applicable policy terms. Participant documents must state the insurer, policy or reference number, contact route, main cover and participant obligations that affect a claim, matching these terms.
Travel and expense reimbursement, inconvenience payments, prorating and any other payment. State clearly when no payment is offered.
documents.drafting_notes_de: CTIS Teil II, Abschnitt P. Pflichtdokument als Erklärung, auch wenn keine Vergütung erfolgt (dann ausdrücklich angeben). Deutsch oder Englisch zulässig; keine Unterschrift. Bei Minderjährigen, nicht Einwilligungsfähigen und Stillenden nur Aufwandsentschädigung bzw. Verdienstausfall. Beträge und Bedingungen müssen mit der Patienteninformation übereinstimmen. Ein Vertragsentwurf Sponsor–Prüfstelle wird ggf. separat unter P2 eingereicht.

documents.name_en: Draft sponsor–site contract and other financial arrangements
documents.trigger_text: The draft contract with a German site contains the financial and operational arrangements assessed under Part II, or other agreements or a funding description apply.

documents.ctis_title: R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_DE
documents.name_en: GDPR and national data-protection compliance statement

template.basis: EudraLex GDPR statement, with a German national data-protection sentence added

documents.content: Confirm compliance with GDPR and, for Germany, that national data-protection rules are respected where GDPR opening clauses apply. If the national point is not in the common statement, submit a separate Part II document.
documents.drafting_notes_de: CTIS Teil II, Abschnitt R. Pflichtdokument. Deutsch oder Englisch zulässig; keine Unterschrift nach der CTR erforderlich. Für Deutschland zusätzlich bestätigen, dass nationale Datenschutzvorschriften beachtet werden, soweit die DSGVO Öffnungsklauseln enthält (siehe Einfügung unten).

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_DE
documents.name_en: Compliance with the use of biological samples
documents.trigger_text: The trial collects, stores, uses or transfers human biological samples.
documents.drafting_notes_de: CTIS Teil II, Abschnitt S. Bedingt: nur einreichen, wenn biologische Proben entnommen, gelagert, verwendet oder übermittelt werden. Deutsch oder Englisch zulässig; keine Unterschrift. Angaben müssen mit Prüfplan, Probenplan, Patienteninformation und ggf. separater Information zur Sekundärnutzung übereinstimmen. Nutzung außerhalb des Prüfplans erfordert in Deutschland eine separate Information und Einwilligung (AKEK).

population_sets.basis: AKEK CTR model text for capable adult patients, version 1.2, 25 November 2022 (AKEK recommends continuing to use it while the revised model is finalised)

population_sets.note: Use only when eligibility depends on being healthy, not merely because no therapeutic benefit is offered. State that no direct benefit is expected; payment for time separate from expense reimbursement.
population_sets.basis: AKEK CTR model text for capable adult healthy volunteers (Probanden)

population_sets.note: Germany has no fixed statutory assent age; bands are drafting aids. A minor with sufficient understanding gives their own written consent in addition to the legal representative. Persistent dissent is decisive. Re-consent at 18 or when capacity is gained. No incentives beyond expenses and loss directly related to participation.

Article 31 conditions. For group-benefit research (Art. 31(1)(g)(ii)) Germany additionally requires a prior written advance statement made while capable; describe how its applicability is verified. Consent process is an investigator responsibility.

All Article 35 conditions at enrolment; later participant and representative information and consent; separate right to object to use of data. No AKEK model; K1 section 6 must describe the site process.
Only for a capable person unable to write. Not for language barriers, incapacity or emergencies.
The enrolled participant cannot consent for the partner. Infant data need the child's legal representatives.
population_sets.basis: AKEK 2018 model text for the pregnant partner and the child's health (predates CTR; update against section 40b and GDPR)

population_sets.note: AKEK separate-document rule: optional use outside the protocol needs its own information and consent; refusing it must not affect main participation. Parent or representative versions when minors or adults without capacity are included.
population_sets.basis: AKEK 2022 model text for optional additional collection of samples and data for use outside the protocol

drafting_rules: Participant documents: AKEK structure and model text are the baseline (AKEK Informed Consent review guideline, effective 9 April 2026). Add all study-specific information. Every deviation from the model text must be justified and visibly identifiable; record the justification as a finding for the reviewer.
Structure the participant information into a short summary of at most two pages (visually highlighted), Part I on procedures and health aspects, and Part II on data protection and samples.
Give risks by frequency where possible: very common (> 10 %), common (1–10 %), uncommon (0.1–1 %), rare (< 0.1 %).
Separate study-specific procedures, risks and burdens from standard care.
Name only the special categories of personal data actually processed, each with a study-specific lay justification and explicit consent.
Express written or electronic consent to processing of personal and health data with the disclosures of section 40b(6) AMG.
Consent interview by an investigator who is a physician or dentist, or a physician or dentist on the trial team.
EU trial number and document version in the running footer; site letterhead on participant documents.

Re-consent for enrolled participants after a material change: a short, version-dated document focused on the change; new participants get the updated full document with revisions marked for ethics review.

Participant templates (JSON): italic text, [square-bracket] notes and "..........." gaps are drafting instructions or gaps; follow them and remove them. Part II templates (DOCX): yellow [EINFÜGEN/FALLS/AUSWAHL/HINWEIS: …] labels. Nothing of either may remain in a final document.

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.germany_note: Use the CTCG pattern; the Germany guide names (e.g. "P1_Compensation trial participants, investigator, funding and other arrangements") are older and superseded by the CTCG examples. Add the language code only where it distinguishes the document; keep it for participant-facing documents.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section from a participant template, for one population.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, training provider, site, legal). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Adolescents
participant_templates.name_de: Information und Einwilligung für Heranwachsende im Alter von etwa 12–17 Jahren
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and consent for adolescents 12–17
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adolescent participants (aged 12 - 17 years).

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Children
participant_templates.name_de: Information und Einwilligung für Kinder im Alter von etwa 7–11 Jahren
participant_templates.role: age-adapted information and consent for children 7–11
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving children participants (aged 7 - 11 years).

participant_templates.name_en: Emergency Enrolment and Deferred Consent Form
participant_templates.name_de: Patienteninformation und Einwilligung zur weiteren Teilnahme nach Notfalleinschluss
participant_templates.role: information and consent after emergency enrolment
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves emergency enrolment before prior informed consent because neither the participant nor a legal representative can provide consent within the required treatment window.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Healthy Adults
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving healthy adult participants (18 or older without a specific health condition). Can be used for non-treated participants when no other template applies.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Legal Representative
participant_templates.name_de: Information für gesetzliche Vertreter und Einwilligungserklärung
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the legal representative of an adult without capacity
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves adult participants who cannot provide informed consent and participation must be authorised by a legally authorised representative.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Limited Capacity
participant_templates.role: adapted information for the adult without capacity
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult lacking consent capacity who retains sufficient understanding to receive adapted information and express assent, willingness or objection. It accompanies the legal representative’s consent.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Adult Patients
participant_templates.role: main information and consent (capable adult patients)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adult patients (18 or older & diagnosed with a specific health condition). Can be used for patients when no other template applies such as re-consent after reaching adulthood, regained capacity, prescreening, or optional substudies or extension arms.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Parents
participant_templates.role: information and consent for parents or legal guardians of a minor
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving minor participants (younger than 18 years).
Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from a pregnant trial participant.

participant_templates.role: information and consent for the pregnant partner of a participant
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from the pregnant partner of a male trial participant.

participant_templates.name_en: Secondary and Future Use of Data or Biosamples
participant_templates.name_de: Information und Einwilligung zur optionalen weiteren Nutzung von Daten und Materialien
participant_templates.role: optional secondary or future use of data or samples
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves optional storage or secondary use of participant data, biological samples or genetic material beyond the mandatory purposes of the main clinical trial.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Impartial Witness
participant_templates.name_de: Patienteninformation und Einwilligung mit unparteiischer Zeugin oder unparteiischem Zeugen
participant_templates.role: consent with impartial witness for a capable participant unable to write
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult participant who has capacity to consent but cannot read, write or sign the standard consent form. The participant decides personally, while an impartial witness confirms and documents the consent process.

population_rules.authority: AKEK (Arbeitskreis Medizinischer Ethik-Kommissionen) guideline for ethics-committee review of participant information and consent, effective 9 April 2026; AMG sections 40a and 40b

minors.reconsent_at_18: DE-PT-main or DE-PT-healthy, when participants can reach 18 during treatment or follow-up
minors.under_7: No age-band template; inform the child in a form appropriate to age and document the information given and the child's response. An expressed refusal is decisive.
minors.note: There is no fixed statutory assent age in Germany; bands are drafting bands. A minor with sufficient understanding signs their own written consent in addition to the legal representative.

adults_without_capacity.note: Group-benefit research additionally needs the prior written advance statement (AMG)

emergency.note: Later legal-representative consent uses DE-PT-legal-rep when the participant stays unable to consent.

separate_document_rules: Optional use of samples or data outside the protocol always needs its own information and consent (DE-PT-secondary), separate from the main consent (AKEK).
A pregnant partner receives a separate document addressed to them; the enrolled participant cannot consent for the partner.
Re-consent of already enrolled participants after a material change: a short version-dated document on the change (AKEK).

population_sets_note: population_sets list which templates a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents.
